title: Like a Refiner’s Fire
old_p1: Malachi said the Lord would be “like a refiner’s fire.” A refiner is a worker who makes silver pure and shiny.
He heats the silver in a very hot fire until it melts. The dirty bits float to the top, and he takes them away.
Malachi said the Lord would “sit as a refiner.” A refiner sits and watches the silver carefully. At last it is clean and shining.
old_p2: Malachi also said “fullers’ soap.” A fuller washed new wool with strong soap until it was soft and white. People knew these jobs well. Malachi was talking about Jesus. Jesus helps us become clean and shining inside.
When we are sorry and try again, Jesus helps us start fresh. His love can make your heart clean and shining too.
p1: Malachi’s people had stopped following the Lord’s ways. So the Lord called to them, “Return unto me.”
Malachi said the Lord would be “like a refiner’s fire.” The refiner heated silver in his fire until it melted.
Then the dirty bits came up, and he took them away. The silver was left clean and shiny. Malachi was talking about Jesus, who makes us clean.
p2: The Lord would also be like “fullers’ soap.” The fuller scrubbed cloth with strong soap until it was white.
When we are sorry and try again, Jesus helps us start fresh. His love can make your heart clean and shining too. Tonight, tell Heavenly Father you will try again.
